# Colors for the Fool

> A tarot site that gives you one lucky color for today. Draw one of the 22 major arcana, read what the card means upright or reversed, then open a short illustrated story that ends with today's lucky color. Free, no sign-up. Written in Japanese and offered in 26 languages, plus two playful historical versions.

How it works:

- Each card has 20 lucky colors: 10 for upright and 10 for reversed, so there are 440 stories in all.
- Every color has its own page with the story, the color's name and hex code, and a painting.
- The same cards, colors and stories exist in every language. Pages share the same path after the language prefix (Japanese has no prefix).
- URL pattern: `/{lang}/cards/{card}/` for a card, `/{lang}/cards/{card}/{color}/` for a color, e.g. https://colorsforthefool.engawa5656.com/en/cards/the-fool/azure/

## Start here

- [Draw a card (English)](https://colorsforthefool.engawa5656.com/en/): the main page. Tap the card to draw, tap again to open today's color.
- [引く（日本語）](https://colorsforthefool.engawa5656.com/): the original Japanese site.
- [お店のタロット](https://colorsforthefool.engawa5656.com/shop/): a tarot made for one shop. Every card ends on that shop's item.
- [Language Reach](https://colorsforthefool.engawa5656.com/en/language-scale.html): why the site is offered in these languages, with speaker, internet and web-content figures.

## Designs

The same 22 cards are drawn in other visual styles. Choosing one changes the deck on every language. The catalog is [デザイン](https://colorsforthefool.engawa5656.com/design/). Each style is one page of 22 pictures:

- [現代ファッション誌風](https://colorsforthefool.engawa5656.com/design/editorial-luxury/)
